summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a 6-K on 24 September 2026 disclosing a routine PDMR shareholding notification under Article 19(3) UK MAR (the US-equivalent Form 4 insider report). Non-Executive Director Catherine Woods and person closely associated James Woods acquired 1,810 ordinary shares of 10 pence each at GBP1.0954 per share on 23 September 2026 via reinvestment of the interim dividend paid 15 September 2026, executed on the London Stock Exchange. No strategic, capital-structure, or control event is present; the filing is an ordinary insider transaction disclosure carrying no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no arbitrage angle to monitor.
